CustomField.formula: IF( OR( Unit__r.Category__c = "MEGA MANSIONS", Unit__r.Category__c = "MANSIONS" ), /* MANSIONS / MEGA MANSIONS logic */ CASE(ProjectName__c, "Nawayef West", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), "2%", "3%" ), "Nawayef East", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), "2%", "3%" ), "AED 0 (0%)" ), /* Non-mansion logic */ CASE(ProjectName__c, "Al Naseem", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), "2%", "4%" ), "Muheira", "4%", "Maysan", "3%", "Nawayef West", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), "2%", "4%" ), "Nawayef East", IF(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2024, 11, 30), "2%", "4%" ), "Nawayef Park View", "3%", "Nawayef Village Townhouses", "4%", "" ) )
CustomField.label: Commission Percentage (SO Creation)
